question: Dr. Atmaram Pandurang and Justice Ranade founded the ________ in Maharashtra espousing principles of enlightenment based on Vedas.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Prarthana Samaj**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Prarthana Samaj was founded in 1867 in Bombay (now Mumbai), Maharashtra.
 
• It was established by Dr. Atmaram Pandurang with the help of Justice Mahadev Govind Ranade and others.
 
• The Samaj was inspired by the Brahmo Samaj and aimed at reforming the social customs and promoting rational thinking.
 
• It emphasized principles of enlightenment based on Vedas and sought to remove caste restrictions, promote widow remarriage, and encourage female education.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Brahmo Samaj**

 
 
• It was founded by Raja Ram Mohan Roy in 1828 in Calcutta (now Kolkata).
 
• The Brahmo Samaj aimed at reforming the Hindu religion and promoting monotheism, discarding idol worship and rituals.
 
• It played a crucial role in the Bengal Renaissance and in promoting social reforms like the abolition of Sati and child marriage.
 
 
 
• **Arya Samaj**
 
 
• Founded by Swami Dayananda Saraswati in 1875 in Bombay.
 
• Arya Samaj advocated for a return to the teachings of the Vedas, promoting values of truth, morality, and social reform.
 
• It opposed caste discrimination, child marriage, and supported women's education and widow remarriage.
 
 
 
• **Bharat Dharma Mahamandal**
 
 
• It was founded in 1902 by Pandit Madan Mohan Malaviya.
 
• The organization aimed at promoting and preserving traditional Hindu values and practices.
 
• It played a significant role in the promotion of Sanskrit education and the revival of Hindu dharma.
